nodes.label: Ottoman Army Marching Toward City Walls
nodes.rationale: AI-generated cinematic digital painting depicting a vast column of armored Ottoman infantry (spearmen/pikemen in helmets and mail, carrying round shields) marching in fog toward a massive crenellated stone fortress wall with multiple towers. Large siege cannons and a military camp of canvas tents are visible in the foreground/midground. Red flags bearing the white Ottoman crescent-and-star emblem are raised throughout the ranks. Dark, moody, overcast sky lends a dramatic, foreboding atmosphere. This visual clearly illustrates the Ottoman army's siege preparations and march against the fortified walls of Constantinople, matching the project's theme of Mehmed the Conqueror's preparation for the conquest of Istanbul.
